chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 410: The Predators’ Council – Blood God Church & Bloodcry Hall Ambush
chapter_meta_description: The Bloodshadow God receives secret intelligence on the Diancai Immortal’s tribulation. But a squad from Bloodcry Hall is hiding in the shadows, their real target being Ji Ning. The storm closes in.
og_title: The Deadly Convergence | Desolate Era Ch. 410
og_description: A shadowy force gives the Blood God Church perfect intel. But elite assassins from Bloodcry Hall are lurking, using them as cover. Their true target: Ji Ning.
twitter_title: The Storm Before the Strike | Desolate Era
twitter_description: Predators circle the Diancai Immortal’s tribulation. The Blood God Church and Bloodcry Hall both prepare to strike, with Ji Ning caught in the crosshairs.

lore_anchors.definition: The leader of the Blood God Church, a powerful cult in the Anchan Commandery powerful enough to contend with the local Beishan clan. His name comes from his blood-red robes and demeanor.
A powerful cult located in the Bloodlake Mountains, a region so densely layered with formations it is considered impregnable by the local ruling clan.

A terrifying and mysterious assassin organization operating within the Grand Xia Dynasty. They are known for their elite killers and their extreme caution regarding the hidden masters of their targets.

The final and most dangerous stage of a Heavenly Tribulation. Unlike the elemental tribulations, the Heart Tribulation attacks the cultivator’s mind and soul, trapping them in a mental world for what feels like years or millennia until they succumb to illusion or break through to enlightenment.

A powerful ocular divine ability activated by Ji Ning. In mythology, the Candle Dragon (Zhulong) is a primordial god whose eyes create day and night. The ability grants him the power to see through nearly all illusions, stealth, and spatial distortions.

The last major cultivation stage before Celestial Immortal. A Returning Void cultivator is an Earth Immortal, a being who has transcended the Five Elements but must undergo the Heavenly Tribulation to achieve immortality. “Tribulation Transcending” specifically refers to the act of enduring this final test.
A method of instantaneous travel used by powerful cultivators. It bypasses physical distance but cannot be used in all locations, as it can be blocked by powerful formations or unstable space.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the mysterious force give intelligence to the Blood God Church?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are using the Blood God Church as a disposable asset to destabilize the region and eliminate the loyal subordinates of the Anchan Beishan clan, serving their larger agenda of overthrowing the established order.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Bloodcry Hall so worried about Ji Ning’s master?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Xianxia, killing a genius often triggers a soul-brand or leaves a Karmic trail that allows a powerful master to instantly locate and annihilate the killer. They are terrified of a True Immortal or an Empyrean God appearing and erasing them.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Can Ji Ning see the assassins with the Candle Dragon’s Gaze?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, very likely. The Candle Dragon’s Gaze is a top-tier ocular divine ability designed to pierce stealth and concealment. The chapter ends with him activating it, setting up the confrontation.
